review.tagline: Memory and context API that extracts user facts and serves profiles to agents
review.summary: Supermemory extracts facts from conversations, tracks updates and contradictions, expires stale facts, and returns a per-user profile plus hybrid RAG and memory search through one API. It ships TypeScript and Python SDKs, an MCP server, plugins for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and OpenCode, and connectors for Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive and GitHub. A local server (default port 6767) runs against any OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini or Ollama model.
review.audience: Developers adding long-term memory to agents and AI coding tools
strengths: Single call returns user profile (static and dynamic facts) plus search results, claimed ~50ms
Local server exposes the same API as the hosted platform; switch by changing baseURL
Handles contradictions and expiry of temporary facts instead of only appending
Wrappers for Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LangGraph, Mastra, OpenAI Agents SDK, n8n
weaknesses: Benchmark claims (#1 on LongMemEval, LoCoMo, ConvoMem) are self-reported
URL ingestion in local mode relies on a hosted reader service
MCP server and plugins default to the hosted service at mcp.supermemory.ai
Local edition differs from Enterprise; README defers details to a separate docs page
needs: Needs LLM provider key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq or Ollama), Docker (optional)
